mapper.select: SELECT tache_id AS id, nom_tache AS nomTache, status, description, date_creation AS dateCreation, date_debut AS dateDebut, date_fin AS dateFin, equipe_id AS equipeId, cip FROM app.Tache where (equipe_id, nom_tache) = (coalesce(#{equipeId}, equipe_id), coalesce(#{nomTache}, nom_tache))

select tache_id as id, nom_tache as nomTache, status, description, date_creation as dateCreation, date_debut as dateDebut, date_fin as dateFin, equipe_id as equipeId, cip from app.Tache where equipe_id = #{equipeId}

select tache_id as id, nom_tache as nomTache, status, description, date_creation as dateCreation, date_debut as dateDebut, date_fin as dateFin, equipe_id as equipeId, cip from app.Tache where cip = #{userId}

select tache_id as id, nom_tache as nomTache, status, description, date_creation as dateCreation, date_debut as dateDebut, date_fin as dateFin, equipe_id as equipeId, cip from app.Tache where equipe_id = #{equipeId} and date_debut <= coalesce(#{dateMax}, date_debut) and date_fin >= coalesce(#{dateMin}, date_fin) order by date_debut asc

select tache_id as id, nom_tache as nomTache, status, description, date_creation as dateCreation, date_debut as dateDebut, date_fin as dateFin, equipe_id as equipeId, cip from app.Tache where tache_id = #{tacheId}

select tache_id as id, nom_tache as nomTache, status, description, date_creation as dateCreation, date_debut as dateDebut, date_fin as dateFin, equipe_id as equipeId, cip from app.Tache where equipe_id = #{equipeId} and date_fin is not null order by date_fin asc

SELECT t.tache_id as id, t.nom_tache as nomTache, t.status, t.description, t.date_creation as dateCreation, t.date_debut as dateDebut, t.date_fin as dateFin, t.equipe_id as equipeId, t.cip FROM app.Tache t WHERE DATE(t.date_fin) = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' AND t.status != 'terminé'
mapper.insert: insert into app.Tache(tache_id, nom_tache, status, description, date_creation, date_debut, date_fin, equipe_id, cip) values (#{tache.id}, #{tache.nomTache}, #{tache.status}, #{tache.description}, #{tache.dateCreation}, #{tache.dateDebut}, #{tache.dateFin}, #{tache.equipeId}, #{tache.cip}) on conflict (tache_id) do update set nom_tache = excluded.nom_tache, status = excluded.status, description = excluded.description
mapper.update: UPDATE app.Tache SET nom_tache = coalesce(#{nomTache}, nom_tache), status = coalesce(#{status}, status), description = coalesce(#{description}, description), date_debut = CASE WHEN #{dateDebut} IS NULL THEN date_debut WHEN #{dateDebut} = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{dateDebut} AS DATE) END, date_fin = CASE WHEN #{dateFin} IS NULL THEN date_fin WHEN #{dateFin} = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{dateFin} AS DATE) END WHERE tache_id = #{tacheId}
